title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
source: recorded by J.Cooper: Hitachi trq-222 stereo casstte recoder using 2 hitachi mics and a 120 minute tape.

ai_review.summary: A powerhouse show highlighted by an incendiary Other One and tight playing, captured on a fair‑quality audience tape.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the band’s tightness and the “spine‑tingling” Other One, noting several wow moments throughout three sets that even included an acoustic New Riders set. The recording is an audience taping – clear enough to hear the drums distinctly but marred by lower‑grade tape quality and a few cuts.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, consistent praise for the musical performance (mostly 5‑star comments) balanced against repeated notes of sub‑par tape quality and occasional song cuts, yielding an overall high but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Lower‑grade taping with some song cuts; drums are clear and unmistakable, but overall mix lacks the polish of a soundboard recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon with an electric first set, an acoustic middle set featuring the New Riders, and a high‑energy third set; tight playing and crowd vibe keep momentum strong throughout.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are clear and unmistakable, providing a powerful backbone that reviewers highlighted.
